name: Moonswirl Coreopsis
description: Compact perennial with striking bi-color yellow and burgundy flowers. Long-blooming and ideal for sunny borders or containers.

name: Mojave Sage
description: Drought-tolerant perennial with spikes of deep blue to purple flowers. Attracts pollinators and thrives in sunny, well-drained soils.

name: Russian Sage
description: Tall perennial with aromatic gray-green foliage and spikes of lavender-blue flowers. Drought tolerant and attracts pollinators.

name: Coral Honeysuckle
description: Climbing vine with tubular coral-red flowers, highly attractive to hummingbirds. Thrives in sunny locations with well-drained soil.

name: Meadow Blazing Star
description: Perennial with tall spikes of bright purple flowers. Attracts butterflies and hummingbirds, ideal for sunny meadows and perennial borders.

name: Chocolate Flower
description: Perennial with daisy-like, deep yellow flowers that emit a subtle chocolate scent. Thrives in sunny, well-drained gardens.

name: Shasta Daisy
description: Classic perennial with large white petals and yellow centers. Long-blooming and ideal for sunny borders and cottage gardens.

name: Bee Balm
description: Perennial with vibrant purple flowers that attract hummingbirds and butterflies. Great for sunny borders.

name: Black-eyed Susan
description: A cheerful perennial with bright yellow daisy-like flowers and dark centers. Attracts pollinators and thrives in sunny borders.

name: Purple Prairie Clover
description: Perennial with spikes of vibrant purple flowers. Attracts pollinators and is highly drought-tolerant, perfect for sunny meadows and prairies.

name: Salvia May Night
description: A hardy perennial with dense spikes of deep violet-blue flowers. Long-blooming and highly attractive to bees and hummingbirds.

name: Iceberg Shrub Rose
description: A classic shrub rose with pure white, double blooms. Highly disease-resistant and long-flowering, ideal for hedges or mixed borders.

name: Sulphurflower Buckwheat
description: Low-growing perennial with clusters of bright yellow flowers. Drought tolerant and ideal for pollinator gardens and rockeries.

name: Beyond Midnight Bluebeard
description: Compact shrub with deep indigo-blue flowers on dark foliage. Attracts pollinators and provides striking late-season color.

name: Arizona Apricot Gaillardia
description: A hardy gaillardia with bright apricot-colored daisy-like flowers. Drought tolerant and long-blooming in sunny borders.

name: Echinacea PowWow Wild Berry
description: Compact coneflower with vibrant pink to deep magenta blooms. Long-blooming and attracts butterflies and bees.

name: Color Guard Yucca
description: Ornamental yucca with variegated green and cream foliage and tall spikes of creamy white flowers. Very drought tolerant.

name: Lipstick Strawberry
description: A compact strawberry variety producing sweet, bright red berries. Excellent for containers, gardens, and attracting pollinators.

name: Purple Pillar® Rose of Sharon
description: Compact hibiscus shrub with upright habit and deep purple flowers. Long-lasting blooms and excellent for hedges or specimen planting.

name: Pink Lemonade Honeysuckle
description: Fragrant climbing honeysuckle with tubular pink and white flowers. Long bloom period and attractive to hummingbirds.

name: Silver Edged Horehound
description: Perennial herb with soft gray-green foliage edged in silver and small white flowers. Attracts pollinators and thrives in sunny, dry conditions.

name: Little Miss Sunshine Stonecrop
description: A compact succulent with star-shaped bright yellow flowers. Drought tolerant and ideal for rock gardens or containers.

name: Miniature Mat Daisy
description: Low-growing perennial with daisy-like flowers in shades of yellow and white. Perfect for edging, rock gardens, or groundcover.

name: Rainbow Mix Lewisia
description: A colorful perennial with rosettes of succulent leaves and bright, cheerful blooms in a variety of colors. Perfect for rock gardens and containers.

name: Millenium Ornamental Onion
description: A striking allium with globe-shaped clusters of deep purple flowers atop tall stems. Long-lasting blooms and excellent for borders.

name: Windflower
description: A delicate perennial with cup-shaped blooms in shades of white, pink, or blue. Ideal for shaded borders and woodland gardens.

name: Pink Grapefruit Yarrow
description: Yarrow with large clusters of bright pink flowers and aromatic foliage. Excellent for pollinator gardens and borders.

name: Sallyrosa April Night Sage
description: Perennial with rich purple flower spikes on compact, aromatic foliage. Long-blooming and attracts pollinators, ideal for sunny borders.

name: Lilac Beauty Yarrow
description: A yarrow variety producing clusters of lilac-colored flowers. Compact, drought-tolerant, and long blooming.

name: Moonshine Yarrow
description: Compact yarrow with bright yellow flowers and silvery-gray foliage. Long bloom period and excellent for borders or containers.

name: Sol Dancer Daisy
description: A hardy daisy with pure white petals and bright yellow centers. Compact habit makes it ideal for borders and cottage gardens.

name: Cat's Pajamas Catmint
description: Compact perennial with aromatic foliage and purple-blue flowers. Long bloom period and highly attractive to bees and butterflies.

name: Walker's Low Nepeta
description: Low-growing perennial catmint with aromatic foliage and sky-blue flowers. Excellent for borders, rock gardens, and pollinator-friendly landscapes.

name: Junior Walker Catmint
description: Compact catmint with aromatic foliage and abundant deep purple-blue flowers. Long-blooming and attractive to pollinators.

name: Blue Grama Grass
description: A native ornamental grass with delicate blue-green seed heads that arch gracefully. Ideal for prairie-style gardens and low-water landscapes.

name: Blue Queen Sage
description: Perennial sage with tall spikes of deep blue flowers. Excellent for borders, attracts pollinators, and tolerates drought.

name: Rocky Mountain Penstemon
description: Native perennial with tall spikes of tubular red flowers. Attracts hummingbirds and thrives in sunny rock gardens.

name: Blue Hyssop
description: Compact herbaceous perennial with aromatic foliage and spikes of vivid blue flowers. Attracts pollinators and great for borders or containers.

name: Agastache cana
description: Perennial with tall spikes of soft lavender flowers, aromatic foliage, and long bloom period. Excellent for pollinator gardens.

name: Jethro Tull Coreopsis
description: Compact perennial with bright golden-yellow daisy-like blooms. Long flowering season and drought tolerant.

name: Rosie Posie Agastache
description: Compact perennial with rosy pink flower spikes. Attracts bees and hummingbirds, with a long summer bloom.

name: Rozanne Geranium
description: Trailing perennial geranium with violet-blue flowers and long blooming season. Ideal for borders, containers, and groundcover.

name: Purple Poppy Mallow
description: Low-growing perennial with large cup-shaped purple flowers. Drought tolerant and excellent for groundcover in sunny areas.

name: Rocky Mountain Columbine
description: A native perennial with nodding blue and white flowers. Attracts hummingbirds and thrives in rock gardens and shaded borders.

name: Rosita Agastache
description: Compact perennial with spikes of bright pink flowers that attract pollinators. Long blooming and heat tolerant.

name: New Vintage™ Violet Yarrow
description: A compact yarrow variety producing clusters of vibrant violet-purple flowers that hold their color well through summer. Excellent for borders, containers, and pollinator gardens.

name: Salvia Blue Queen
description: Perennial with striking deep blue flower spikes that attract hummingbirds and butterflies. Thrives in full sun with well-drained soil.

name: Butterfly Weed
description: A showy native milkweed with clusters of brilliant orange flowers. Essential for Monarch butterflies and drought tolerant.

name: Wild Strawberry
description: A native groundcover with white flowers in spring followed by small sweet red strawberries. Attracts pollinators and wildlife.

name: Rose Milkweed
description: A native perennial with fragrant clusters of rose-pink flowers. A vital host plant for Monarch butterflies and excellent for rain gardens.

name: Rocky Mountain Goldenrod
description: A hardy native perennial with clusters of bright golden-yellow flowers. Excellent for pollinator gardens and tolerant of poor soils.

name: Thumbelina Leigh Dwarf English Lavender
description: A compact English lavender with sweetly fragrant deep purple flower spikes. Perfect for containers, edging, and small gardens.

name: Tall Coreopsis
description: A tall native perennial producing bright yellow daisy-like blooms on slender stems. Excellent for naturalized plantings and attracts butterflies.

name: Rose Marvel Salvia
description: Compact perennial salvia with vivid rose-pink flower spikes that bloom heavily in spring and rebloom through summer. Deer resistant and pollinator friendly.

name: Blue Boa Agastache
description: A showy perennial with dense spikes of deep violet-blue flowers that bloom from summer into fall. Highly attractive to hummingbirds and butterflies.

name: Hummelo Betony
description: A hardy perennial with upright spikes of violet-purple flowers and tidy clumps of dark green foliage. Known for its long bloom period and excellent garden performance.

name: Nepeta Blue Wonder
description: A compact catmint with aromatic foliage and masses of deep blue flowers that bloom from spring into fall. Loved by pollinators and deer resistant.

name: Sterntaler Coreopsis
description: A cheerful perennial with bright golden-yellow daisy-like blooms accented by a deep burgundy center. Compact and long-blooming, Sterntaler Coreopsis is drought tolerant and thrives in sunny borders or containers.
